purpose: Define deterministic activation order for the twenty curated Mega Drive AAA skills when a real user prompt triggers multiple domains.

global_order.reason: Classify the claim, separate ambition from evidence, and route to domain skills.
When the prompt concerns a full scene/level, bind camera, assets, collision, entities, audio and evidence before production.
Visual source truth, palette ownership and asset constraints must be settled before runtime code depends on them.
VDP, CRAM, SAT, DMA and scroll effects define whether the visual ambition is physically possible.
Runtime code must consume the approved asset/hardware contracts instead of inventing its own assumptions.
Audio ownership and channel/PCM risk must be planned before closeout if the prompt includes sound.
Only review, emulator/VDP evidence and release packaging can close implementation claims.

conflict_rules.conflict: sprite sheet generation vs rejected prior sheet
conflict_rules.resolution: sprite-asset-budget-curator must reject the failed sheet as generation source and return to the approved model sheet.

conflict_rules.conflict: visual vibrance vs hardware palette budget
conflict_rules.resolution: palette-cram-curator decides CRAM ownership before visual-excellence-standards can approve color.
hscroll-linescroll-road-fx defines display distortion while level-manifest-architect and collision-system-architect preserve gameplay-space mapping.

conflict_rules.conflict: software tile rasterizer vs DMA budget
conflict_rules.resolution: software-tile-rasterizer must hand off dirty upload size to vram-streaming-dma-queue and megadrive-vdp-budget-analyst.
game-state-transition-architect coordinates CRAM ownership with palette-cram-curator and raster-palette-hint-director.

conflict_rules.conflict: AAA claim vs missing emulator evidence
conflict_rules.resolution: aaa-pipeline-guardian blocks the claim until emulator-vdp-evidence-curator maps proof to every runtime/visual claim.

prompt_classes.closeout: emulator-vdp-evidence-curator when runtime proof is claimed
emulator-vdp-evidence-curator if runtime behavior is claimed tested

phase5_routing.note: input-system-sgdk and camera-system-sgdk are the canonical owners added in Phase 5; they route inside the runtime_architecture class.
